plan.title: School Performance Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Key indicators for school enrolment, infrastructure, and gender balance.

panels.title: Total Schools
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Enrolment Trend
panels.sql: SELECT year, SUM(girls) AS total_girls, SUM(boys) AS total_boys FROM (SELECT '2022' AS year, Girls 2022 AS girls, Boys 2022 AS boys FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2023' AS year, Girls 2023 AS girls, Boys 2023 AS boys FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2024' AS year, Girls 2024 AS girls, Boys 2024 AS boys FROM school_enrolment_by_year) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Enrolment by Block (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT Block, Girls 2024 AS girls, Boys 2024 AS boys FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY girls + boys DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Schools with No Drinking Water
panels.sql: SELECT School Code, School Name FROM school_infrastructure WHERE Drinking water = 'No' LIMIT 10

panels.title: Schools with Functional Toilets (Girls)
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM school_infrastructure WHERE "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'Yes'

panels.title: Infrastructure Gaps
panels.sql: SELECT "Drinking water", COUNT(*) AS count FROM school_infrastructure GROUP BY 1

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides a snapshot of school performance across key areas. The enrolment trend shows overall student population changes over the past three years.  The bar chart highlights enrolment differences by block in 2024.  A table lists schools lacking access to clean drinking water, indicating a critical infrastructure need. Finally, a pie chart visualizes the distribution of schools with and without access to drinking water, offering a quick view of the overall infrastructure gap.
